name: Listmonk
description: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager
composeYaml:
services:
  listmonk:
    image: 'listmonk/listmonk:v6.0.0'
    environment:
      - 'LISTMONK_app__address=0.0.0.0:9000'
      - LISTMONK_db__host=postgres
      - LISTMONK_db__database=listmonk
      - LISTMONK_db__user=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - LISTMONK_db__password=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - LISTMONK_db__port=5432
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - 'listmonk-data:/listmonk/uploads'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:9000'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  listmonk-initial-database-setup:
    image: 'listmonk/listmonk:v6.0.0'
    command: './listmonk --install --yes --idempotent'
    restart: 'no'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - LISTMONK_db__host=postgres
      - LISTMONK_db__database=listmonk
      - LISTMONK_db__user=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - LISTMONK_db__password=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - LISTMONK_db__port=5432
  postgres:
    image: 'postgres:18-alpine'
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=listmonk
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
    volumes:
      - 'postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: High performance, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager with a modern dashboard.
